variant.template: tool call <k> of <n> made while handling that request; <n-k> later call(s) followed it
variant.templateHashMethod: SHA-256 of the literal template's UTF-8 bytes, without a trailing newline
variant.coordinates: k is the one-based position among completed tool parts in chronological message/part order within the production ordinary-request group; n is that group's completed-call count through the invocation point. No timestamps.
unchanged: native summaries shared by both arms
singleton requests, concurrency four, 30-second timeout and no retries

development.metricDefinition: TP/FP/FN/TN and precision/recall use agreed labels only; total keeps include unresolved keeps. Agreed superseded requires both annotators to label false with reason superseded.

rules.supersession: Baseline superseded keeps >= 1 and candidate superseded keeps strictly fewer
rules.precision: Candidate precision >= 0.80, TP >= 3 and FP <= baseline FP
rules.stability: Repeat meets supersession, recall and precision against the same baseline, with <= 3 keep-decision changes across all 48 cases

selection.stabilityFailure: Repeat quality gates failed; request-order decisions were identical

secondaryMetrics.sizeMeasure: UTF-8 bytes and production countGptTokens(JSON.stringify(input) + output) of full kept tool I/O; not net trim accounting or overall model-request budget
secondaryMetrics.interpretation: Added wording may have encouraged higher superseded scores; causality was not isolated

usage.billedInputTokensSource: API usage.input_tokens, not a byte-derived estimate

provenance.questionHashMethod: SHA-256 of UTF-8 Python json.dumps(question, sort_keys=True), default separators and ensure_ascii=True
provenance.historyLimit: The protocol records append/freeze history and an earlier protocol version whose full difference was not retained. This artifact binds the final pre-inference freeze; it does not repair that history.
provenance.contentPolicy: Aggregate counts and evidence hashes only; no cases, prompts, tool outputs, generated summaries, label notes or credentials. Hashes cannot reconstruct missing private content.

limitations: Development-only selection; fresh held-out inference was not admitted
Small clustered cohort from two development projects, mostly task and skill calls and some finished-task segments
No edit-tool cases or development reads later edited or reread
Partial label inspection and one unresolved development case
Baseline has one pass; baseline variance is unknown
Candidate repeats are the same cases, not independent samples
No held-out or general production accuracy claim; no universal conclusion about the frozen 0.80 threshold
Unused paid budget is not authorization to keep tuning this rejected variant
